about: Lac Ste. Anne County is a municipal district in central Alberta west of Edmonton—not a city. Lake communities around Lac Ste. Anne, hamlets, and parkland farms share a popular cottage and pilgrimage region toward the Whitecourt corridor. About 11,000 people live in Lac Ste. Anne County.
